steps.caption: Companies lists every account. Filter by name, add one, or show archived ones.
Find Zentrix Analytics and open it.
'Why do we believe this?' shows the source behind the facts on the page.
Edit changes the basic details; 'As of' shows the page as it was on an earlier date.
The tabs, each with a count: one part of the story per tab.
Overview — Identity: the basic facts. Unknown stays 'unknown' — nothing is guessed.
Next actions in short, with the dates that come from the lease.
Locations: HQ, offices and sites. Add one, or pull office sites from leases.
Evidence trail lists every source; Shared with shows who else can see this company.
Archive asks for a reason, and goes through Review like any other change.
Occupancy: where they sit today — buildings, leases, area, expiry dates.
People: who works there, grouped by role, with how well you know them.
Each person shows influence and relationship level — fill these in as you learn.
Requirements: what they are looking for — size, place, dates.
Signals: news that may mean they need space — marked unconfirmed until checked.
Scores: how worth targeting the company is.
Every score lists its reasons and what is still missing.
Timeline: every call, note, email and change, newest first.
Meetings: past and upcoming meetings with this company.
Deals: opportunities in progress. Documents: leases, LOIs and files linked here.
Documents: files linked to this company.
Next actions: what to do next and when, most urgent first.
Open one to plan the work, or turn it into a task.
